message.content:
**Average (median) house price in California (2024‑mid)**  
≈ **$850 000 – $900 000** (USD)

> *Source:* Zillow Home Value Index (ZHVI) and Redfin Market Trends, both of which report California’s median home price hovering around **$875 k** in the first half of 2024.  
> 
> *Note:* The figure represents the *median* price (the middle value when all listings are sorted). The *average* (mean) price is typically a bit higher because a few very expensive properties pull the mean upward, but the median is the most commonly cited metric for “average” home cost in real‑estate discussions.
